newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Life says completes U.S. acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Irish Life says completes U.S. acquisition.

text.p: Irish Life Plc said on Monday that it had completed the purchase of Guarantee Reserve in the U.S. for 100 million Irish pounds.

Irish Life is financing the purchase from its own resources and expects to secure a return in the order of 12 percent net from Guarantee Reserve compared to the four percent net which is available on the cash which Irish Life is using for its purchase.
Following the acquisition, Irish Life's operations in the U.S. will account for 33 percent of group premium income and 33 percent of group embedded value.
